title: 毎日王冠の後に・我等、此処に集いて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she wins the race, the phenomenal running Mejiro Ardan witnesses from Oguri Cap and the other racers leaves a lasting impression on her. Oguri Cap and Mejiro Ardan promise to race again at the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Yaeno Muteki arranges to meet with Mejiro Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O, then hands each of them a letter of challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The letters contain a proposal to settle their score at the autumn Tenno Sho—a race that Oguri Cap will also be entering—and to show the world that they are the true top three.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan's heart soars when she hears Yaeno Muteki's suggestion. The three rivals, illuminated by the setting sun, vow to battle for supremacy at the autumn Tenno Sho.
